title: Silas and the Passage
author: Edmund Pemberton
blurb: Dominic Sandoval, a railroad engineer with a map of closed lines, keeps moving because stopping costs more. But when the river gives up a chest stamped with a dead nation's seal, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must cross the range ahead of the snows before the dry season ends.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
